scope: shared garment editor category/subtype transitions and temporary field cleanup

rules.initial_load: preserve saved values exactly in the form; no cleanup on load
rules.new_registration: clear incompatible or unclassified subtype/fit drafts without confirmation
rules.existing_edit: confirm before clearing incompatible or unclassified subtype/fit drafts; cancellation preserves category and input state
rules.compatible_values: retain subtype supported by target category and fit supported by resulting category/subtype
rules.custom_values: preserve stored originals; cannot assume cross-category compatibility, so confirm temporary cleanup in existing edits
rules.subtype_typing: separate pending text from applied subtype; apply with button or Enter; save applies/reviews pending text before serialization
rules.foreign_standard_subtype: reject new application under wrong category; no automatic rewrite of legacy originals
rules.return_to_previous_category: do not restore cleared drafts automatically; reopening an unsaved edit reloads the stored original
rules.common_fields: retain name, colors, seasons, tags, materials, thickness, notes and photo
rules.persistence: writes only on explicit save; serialize applied subtype/fit only; retain original server CAS identity
